run_download_data_cli: run the CLI to download handwriting full data to a specified output directory
run_download_small_subset: run the CLI with --small-subset flag to download a small subset of discrete gestures data
run_download_wrist_data: run the CLI to download wrist task data with no cleanup option enabled
refactor_download_data_function: refactor the download_data function to support additional task types beyond handwriting and gestures
review_main_cli_options: review the main CLI entry point and its click options for task selection and output directory
